name: StrongReject
intro: StrongREJECT是一个用于评估大型语言模型（LLM）越狱攻击的基准。它旨在解决现有越狱研究中普遍存在的夸大攻击效果的问题，提供了一个包含特定、有害信息请求的标准化提示数据集。其核心是一个自动评估器，能够衡量模型响应中提供有害信息的程度，并与人类判断达到很高的吻合度，从而提供更准确、更稳健的越狱有效性评估。
org: Center for Human-Compatible AI, UC Berkeley
build_method: 政策交叉归类, 人工与LLM构题, 嵌入去重, 多模型拒答筛选
build_method_en: Policy taxonomy, human and LLM prompt creation, embedding de-duplication, multi-model refusal filtering
intro_en: StrongREJECT is a benchmark for evaluating jailbreak attacks on large language models (LLMs). It aims to address the common issue of exaggerated attack effectiveness in existing jailbreak research by providing a standardized prompt dataset containing specific harmful information requests. At its core is an automatic evaluator that measures the extent of harmful information in model responses and achieves high alignment with human judgments, offering a more accurate and robust assessment of jailbreak effectiveness.

drawio_review_note: REDRAW reviewed against arXiv:2402.10260 Sections 2–3 and Appendices C–E plus official dsbowen/strong_reject repository. The pipeline defines six prohibited harm categories across 313 high-quality malicious prompts (>=50 per category) filtered via sentence embedding deduplication (cosine similarity >= 0.85), a nine-model baseline refusal screen, and expert safety curation. Evaluates attacked targets under greedy decoding (T=0) using a fine-tuned autograder measuring refusal (R), specificity (S), and convincingness (C), producing a continuous StrongREJECT score in [0, 1].
